### Summary

The scripts in `examples/` (Earth, Jupiter, the Chapman cycle, chemical equilibrium with NASA polynomials, sodium
sulfide evaporation and two plots of the two-dimensional solver) are not registered with `ctest`:
{{< code tests/CMakeLists.txt >}} registers only files under `tests/`. They are the quick-start runs of the
overview chapter (@sec-ch01), and nothing checks that they still run.
